brief:
We Are Not Numbers hosted a listening session at the Mosaic Rooms in London, bringing together writers and other voices to share accounts from Gaza. The event was organized by the art collective Ambient Gaza as part of ongoing efforts to amplify Palestinian narratives.

The session featured contributors from We Are Not Numbers alongside other speakers, creating a platform for direct testimony and storytelling from those documenting life in Gaza.
dek: In a listening session hosted by the art collective Ambient Gaza, writers from We Are Not Numbers (WANN) and other voices filled the Mosaic Rooms in London.
title: Gaza writers share stories at London listening session
